description: NUREG/CR-2680, the Seismic Safety Margins Research Program Equipment Fragility Data Base (UCRL-53038, Revision 1), was compiled by L. E. Cover at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory for the NRC, with the manuscript completed in January 1983. Part of the Seismic Safety Margins Research Program was directed at generating a fragility data base for equipment used in control and safety systems in commercial nuclear power plants. Component fragility data were compiled in various forms depending on content, intended use and level of reduction and stored in a relational data base on the laboratory's CDC 7600 computers; the report describes the structure of the data base and presents its contents through tables, and is a revision of an earlier report with additional data and a more usable presentation. Coverage is U.S. commercial nuclear plant equipment. Access: a 2.66 MB PDF on the NRC page, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: the original relational data base is not offered and the values date from the early 1980s. It suits seismic fragility curve inputs for nuclear plant equipment in probabilistic risk models, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
